pages.text: The Akaishi Transformer converts raw ores, Lapis Dust or Akaishi Dust into standardized bases and concentrates: one input to one output (Akaishi Dust is processed 9 at a time). Each operation takes 100 ticks at 15 energy/tick with a 100k internal buffer.$(li)Lapis Dust → Cooling Base$(li)Coal, Iron, Copper, Gold, Redstone, Lapis, Diamond, Emerald or Quartz (ore or deepslate) → the matching Ore Base$(li)Ancient Debris → Ancient Debris Base$(li)9 Akaishi Dust → 1 Compressed Akaishi Essence$(li)Compressed Akaishi Essence → Akaishi Ore Base

Bases are not used directly; they are intermediate materials that unlock advanced recipes:$(li)Cooling Base + Copper Ingot → Poor Heat Sink; the heat-sink line starts here (see $(l:akaishi:fuel_system)Fuel & Cooling$(/l))$(li)Iron, Gold, Diamond and Ancient Debris Bases → the four Catalyst tiers$(li)Copper, Redstone and Lapis Bases → the Auto Collector upgrade line$(li)Other bases feed the fuel canner, wireless core and other recipes; see JEI$(br2)The complete base list is in the Ore Bases entry.

Feedstock sources are described in $(l:akaishi:pulverizer)Pulverizer$(/l) and $(l:akaishi:dusts)Dusts$(/l); the complete family and its recipes are in $(l:akaishi:ore_bases)Ore Bases$(/l). Note: Akaishi Ore is pulverized into Compressed Akaishi Essence first, and the Akaishi Ore Base is produced from that concentrate rather than directly from the ore.
